title: Brazilian Tables for Poultry and Swine — Composition of Feedstuffs and Nutritional Requirements
publisher: Federal University of Viçosa, Department of Animal Science

sourceAnomalies.description: The published 43-49 day phase has average weight 3.713 kg while the published weight range is 3.11-3.70 kg.
The hot-climate table publishes the same average weights as Table 2.28 while using different weight ranges.
Rice bran poultry Met+Cys SID is printed as 0.33% with a digestibility coefficient of 79.9%, although 0.33/0.47 is about 70.2%; FeedSport preserves the printed coefficient.

Corn high-oil grain prints poultry digestibility coefficients for alanine 81.0%, glycine 76.0%, serine 81.2%, proline 94.5%, and tyrosine 95.4%, matching the average-corn coefficients despite other amino-acid coefficients differing. FeedSport preserves the printed values.

Fish meal 62% CP prints poultry SID Met+Cys as 1.12% with a digestibility coefficient of 86.9%, even though total Met+Cys is 2.44% and methionine alone is 1.57%. FeedSport preserves the printed value and records the inconsistency.
